name: Eurostat Dissemination API
summary: Official EU statistics (GDP, inflation, employment, population, energy, trade) via a keyless JSON-stat/SDMX API.
description: Thousands of harmonised datasets covering the EU, euro area, member states and candidate and EFTA countries across economy, demography, labour, environment, energy, health and trade. The Statistics API returns JSON-stat 2.0 (or TSV); SDMX 2.1/3.0 endpoints expose structure and data. Filter datasets by dimension codes such as geo, time and unit.

rate_limit.summary: No numeric limit documented; large requests are asynchronous or size-limited (about 50 sub-indicators per synchronous request).

example.response_excerpt: {"version": "2.0", "class": "dataset", "label": "Gross domestic product (GDP) and main components (output, expenditure and income) - annual data", "source": "ESTAT", "updated": "2026-11-05T23:00:00+0100", "value": {"0": 3089797.2}, "status": {"0": "p"}, "id": ["freq", "unit", "na_item", "geo", "time"], "size": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]}

coverage.geographic: EU27, euro area, EFTA and candidate countries

agent_notes: JSON-stat returns a flat value array indexed by dimension strides (id and size lists), so decode it rather than reading positions by eye. Dataset codes such as nama_10_gdp must be discovered via the data browser or the dataflow catalogue. Pin every dimension (geo, time, unit) to keep responses small.
caveats: The JSON-stat value array needs a decoder.
Dataset codes are not guessable; use the dataflow catalogue.
Update timing is per dataset (example updated 2026-11-05).

verification.notes: The research run needed curl -k for a redirect/cert quirk in its sandbox; not an API issue.
